title: byte-for-byte reproducibility — peer-review evidence bundle

claims.C1: REPRODUCIBLE=1 ⇒ byte-identical generation across processes, model reloads, and interleaved prompts (fixed local hardware)
claims.C2: local embedding model is byte-deterministic, including across batch compositions

howToFalsify: Recompute sha256(utf8(fullText)) for any generation and compare against the recorded hash; diff any two fullText fields that a check asserts equal. Re-run: npx tsx verify/review-cli.ts --model <model> --prompt "<your prompt>". Any single-byte difference in an asserted-equal pair falsifies C1/C2 on that machine.

environment.note: GPU/VRAM not introspectable from Node — reviewers should record GPU model and driver separately.

parameters.prompt: Decompose "why does my team keep missing deadlines even though everyone works hard" into its seven rhetorical arcs. Answer with one short phrase per arc.
parameters.interleavePrompt: Decompose "a suspension bridge" into its seven rhetorical arcs. Answer with one short phrase per arc.

checks.name: embedder-repeat
checks.claim: same embed batch twice → identical vectors
checks.falsifiedBy: any component differing between the two embeddings of the same batch
checks.procedure: embed ["a wooden chair","drives nails and breaks objects","bridge"] twice via mxbai-embed-large:latest; compare full JSON serialisations

checks.name: embedder-batch-mix
checks.claim: same text among different batch-mates → identical vector
checks.falsifiedBy: any component of the 'bridge' vector differing between the two batch compositions
checks.procedure: compare the 'bridge' vector from the 3-text batch against the 'bridge' vector from a 2-text batch with a different companion

checks.name: replay-across-processes
checks.claim: 3 independent OS processes, same frozen request → byte-identical output
checks.falsifiedBy: any two worker outputs differing by one byte (compare fullText fields directly)
checks.procedure: spawn 3 fresh processes; each runs the full frozen sequence (warm-up + kept + witness) and returns its output
